ar_body: يستخدم باحثو Isomorphic Labs قدرات Gemini 4 Argon متعددة الوسائط لاستخراج البيانات من براءات الاختراع الكيميائية.
body: Auditing chemistry literature usually means weeks of manual, error-prone reading, where a molecule’s structure can sit 50 pages away from its experimental readout. At Isomorphic Labs, researchers Brian Bender and Santosh Adhikari are using Gemini 4 Argon’s multimodal capabilities to help tackle this early research bottleneck. The model synthesizes dense papers and extracts patent data into structured reports in an afternoon instead of a month, helping teams uncover connected insights faster.
